privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: {{site}} does not collect personal data, run analytics, or serve advertising cookies. The site only stores preferences on your device so the experience stays familiar between visits.
privacy.external: When you open a tool link, you leave this site and visit the tool provider's website. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of external sites.
privacy.changes: If this policy changes, we will update the date above.

terms.title: Terms of Service
